description: Prepare VSCode for screen sharing: Close personal files (personal_notes.txt, salary_negotiation.md, job_applications.csv, password_manager.py, diary.txt) but keep work files (presentation_demo.py, client_api.js, README.md). Change editor font size to 18-20px. Change terminal font size to 16-18px. Set zoom level to 150% or higher (window.zoomLevel >= 1.5). Change theme to a light or high-contrast presentation theme (e.g., 'Default Light+', 'Light+', 'Quiet Light', 'Solarized Light', or any theme with 'Light' or 'High Contrast' in the name). Disable minimap (set editor.minimap.enabled to false). Save settings (Ctrl+S in settings or they auto-save). Goal is to make VSCode readable for screen sharing with remote viewers.
